ADMITTED_BOUNDED.action: Host publishes with review --state PUBLISHED and the inspected expected head.

EVIDENCE_PENDING.action: Run an independent verifier; import with source-project, then review ADMITTED_BOUNDED using --source and --scope. Self-test PASS is insufficient.

PROPOSED.action: Host inspects the immutable proposal, then reviews it into EVIDENCE_PENDING or REJECTED.

PUBLISHED.action: Query with a new Run and independently known context; inspect the evidence bundle. Adoption and causal benefit remain UNKNOWN.

PUBLISHING.action: Retry review --state PUBLISHED with the current inspected head to finish the same publication, or withdraw.

REJECTED.action: Retain this rejected proposal; submit a corrected proposal with a new candidate key.

SUPERSEDED.action: Retain this history and query the independently published replacement.

WITHDRAWN.action: This candidate is excluded from recommendations. New evidence requires a new reviewed candidate.
